notes.title: 2.0.1 Patch notes
notes.content:
Good day friends,

A few small things to add to this update.

The most important one, is MacOS version now has the updated version as well!

We've also fixed a few minor bugs.

And last but not least, there are a few things to mention:

[olist]
 - if the game does not accept input in the level selection part, it's due to the save files being corrupted, or unreadable by the new system. You can navigate to the savefile and delete it.

Default paths should be:
- windows: Users/[YourName]/AppData/LocalLow/PointFiveTeam/RAM BOE
- linux: home/.config/unity3d/PointFiveTeam/RAM BOE
- mac: ~/Library/Application Support/PointFiveTeam/RAM BOE

 - as for the custom levels in the workshop, the current created ones won't work anymore as the system was changed and improved. Only the ones created after the 2.0 update will work. Thank you for your understanding.
[/olist]

Have fun playing!

notes.title: Graphics detail
notes.content:
Hello friends and happy new year!

As it's been a while and as we're heading to the last stretch before the update is live, we're here to give the final update before the patch.

From the graphical standpoint of the game, it has changed a lot. Without giving away too many spoilers, here are a few things you can expect:


 the most important one is our little wooly friend - he's getting an upgrade in model and animations!
 the puzzle blocks are also getting a makeover and a general more clean esthetic
 we're also upgrading the background environment and vfx for a more stylish cartoony look
 last, but not least, we're updating the lighting and adding a whole bunch of post processing to make the game look better


Hope you're as excited as we are and see you soon!

notes.title: Story details
notes.content:
Happy Friday Friends,

Hope you're having an awesome start to the weekend, as we're going to add to the excitement with more news. 

This time we're giving away a sneak peek on the story aspect:


 the main highlight of this update is the story animation will change and will be upgraded
 the story itself will not change, but it will have a bit extra text and some small changes for consistency
 the narrator will change also so hope you'll enjoy the new VO
 last, but not least, I will leave you with a few screenshots taken from the new story graphics:

notes.title: Gameplay details
notes.content:
Hello beautiful people and hope you're having an awesome start of September.

As promised, during the next period until the upgrade patch is done, we will be give you guys a sneak peak from multiple perspectives - gameplay, graphics, story and other miscellaneous changes.

In this update we will be touching on gameplay matters, so grab your popcorn and enjoy the read:


 - from the get go, we will not be touching the core mechanics, so all changes will focus on enhancing what already exists
 - our little wooly mountain climber will be getting a sugar rush buff, so he'll be moving around the map faster and the input will be much tighter than it currently is. We know how that was annoying as it caused over-pushing and running off the cliff a lot of times. Also nobody likes a slowpoke, so put some muscle in it Boe.
 - speaking of input, as this upgrade is focused a lot for steam deck, we've removed mouse control, so you will only use keyboard or gamepad controls
 - there will still be two difficulty modes, a casual mode where you can't fall off the platform and you can't push important runestones off either, as well as removing the timer. Yes, we've heard your feedback and we're revamping the timer. The challenge mode will have what the casual mode doesn't - falling, pushing and timer.
 - as mentioned above, level timer won't tick down anymore. In casual mode it won't exist at all and in challenge mode it's replaced by a stopwatch, meaning it will count from 0 upward and will be used as a means for time-trial - that you will need that for one of the 3 souls from each level completion. TLDR; you can take your time on both difficulties as the game won't end on time anymore :D
 - camera movement is getting changes as well, you will be able to move the camera, now isometric, at 90 degrees and will also have a top down mode, depending on what preference you have while playing
 - last but not least, we're also adding a couple of extra level, focused on the breakable falling tiles under your feet, as we feel that mechanic was not explored enough.
  - more than that, a handful of quality of life changes that everyone will enjoy

notes.title: Patch 1.3.1
notes.content:
Happy New Year Everyone!
And with the new year comes the new patch with a bunch of bugfixes which include:

- the level creation achievement now unlocks properly (we advise you to make a new level and after uploading it successfully, restart the game and you should get the achievement)
- fixed a bug where level 53 and 54 wouldn't unlock
- fixed a visual bug where it would show the number of souls you got on the last run of a level now the best run of that level
- sandbox level name now shows properly
- fixed a bug where you couldn't try your level if you edited it and taken the snapshot again
- saving for cloud now updates every time you finish levels rather than when you quit the game
- updated the level vegetation

notes.title: Patch 1.1.2
notes.content:
A small patch is underway with fixes and extra goodies.
- 5 new achievements
- added banners to indicate what levels contain parts of the story
- updated the game description on steam

- fixed a bug where if you finished an achievement you wouldn't get the end level menu
- fixed a bug where the difficulty of the special levels wouldn't reset on finishing/exiting that level

And that's not all! During the summer sale (23June - 4 July) the game will be 25% off!

Thank you.

notes.title: The awakening of Thrym - Upcoming Update
notes.content:
http://pointfiveteam.eu/assets/pics/awakening%20of%20thrym.jpg 

Hi guys, a warm welcome and a huge thank you to everyone who came on board the ram-express. We have heard/read all the comments, reviews, critiques and tips on improving our game and we are happy to announce a major update.
The Awakening of Thrym is going to add a lot of content to the game. I don't want to spoil everything but I will list a few hints that would give you a general idea of the changes:

 more levels
 more story
 more soundtrack
 more bugfixes
 more gameplay fixes
 and the biggest thing is something that starts with sand and ends with box (let's see if you can guess ːsteamhappyː )


We can't give a release date yet (one or two weeks from now, it might take more but not likely) so we will just say it will be SOON.
